paragraphs.text: The stretchy suit covered most of Bella's orange fur, but the cape didn't hide her tail. And the mask didn't hide her pointy ears. Would anyone recognize her?

Then, she heard a voice cry, "Help!"
Jumping up, Bella meowed, "Supercat to the rescue!"
